content.short: Frigg makes sustainable finance accessible, efficient and composable.
content.description: Frigg has built the Frigg Standard, a comprehensive suite of compliance, financial and technical workflows designed to provide easy access to the real-world asset class for both investors and project developers. The platform enables issuers to connect directly with investors seeking access to sustainable projects with measurable impact at the asset level, while delivering clear guidance on engagement steps and supporting consistent documentation, data sharing and transparency across transactions.
content.meta: Frigg provides the Frigg Standard, a workflow suite for access to real-world assets. Discover Frigg and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
